title: Fabulous cruise with good food.
text: This was a lunch cruise along the river. The views were fabulous and peaceful. The food initially appeared to be small portions, but just kept coming so that by the end of the lunch it was impossible to move. The staff looked after us very well.
author: Eve_S

title: 2.5 hour trip 02/11/26
text: Very relaxed, informative and good value for money overall. The food was excellent and drinks were included, up until the dessert was served.
author: Michael_B

title: River trip
text: Great trip longer than expected which was good,
author: M3305NMlindae

title: Well worth it
text: Really enjoyable boat trip with lots of various food and drink   The tour operators were extremely friendly and said goodbye with a glass of Prosecco for everyone
author: David_S

title: This "Guadalquivir cruise" is worth it.
text: They are reliable, the food is good and it is very enjoyable. The food is very good with some typical dishes from the area.
author: Manuel_T

title: Charming cook
text: The setting was lovely. The food was great. The service was friendly and helpful. Great to do in the evening.
author: Jeannie_A

title: Relaxation and good company!! Very satisfied with the 5-course tasting and the dessert!! Everything was great!!
text: Comfortable ride along the Guadalquivir with splendid service and a delicious tasting !! Congratulations to Chef Blas for his friendliness and his skill in the kitchen! Highly recommended!! We loved it!!
author: _lvaroj525

title: Amazing highly recommend
text: Wonderful cruise food was so tasty staff were all brilliant. We were shocked how few passengers left a well deserved tip.
author: wendyt221

title: Awesome
text: Everything was great, the chef very nice and the food was delicious and of good quality and the waitresses very attentive.
author: JUANMANUEL_R

title: The cruise was exactly as...
text: The cruise was exactly as described. The food and drinks  were delicious and the river was very scenic. Well worth the money!
author: Nadine_F
